newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Soporcel maintains policy of cutting debt.
newsitem.headline: Soporcel maintains policy of cutting debt.

text.p: Portuguese pulp group Soporcel-Sociedade Portuguesa de Celulose maintains its policy of reducing debt, which stood at 36.7 billion escudos at the end of the first half, 30 percent less than the same year-ago period, its president said.
"For some years Soporcel's policy has been to cut debt and we are continuing on that path," Alvaro Barreto told reporters during the presentation of the company's six-month results.
He said Soporcel's debt servicing costs were presently three percent of its sales.
Soporcel posted a net profit of 2.8 billion escudos in the first half of 1997, compared with a loss of 1.0 billion in the same year-ago period.
